preserveIntent.originalTitle: Jalapeño delivers more throughput per kilowatt
preserveIntent.originalMessage: Jalapeño delivers higher peak mixed TPS per kW than the comparison systems across GPT-OSS, DeepSeek R1, and Kimi K2.5.
preservedElements: GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek R1 670B, and Kimi K2.5 1T in the original order
Jalapeño versus GB200 or GB300 comparison for every model
Exact peak mixed TPS per kW values
OpenAI source URL and official comparison labels
changedElements: Recomposed the comparisons as a grouped horizontal bar chart so all six exact values remain readable
Used direct labels with the comparison hardware name and exact comma-formatted value
Added a short plain-language Korean headline and subtitle
Kept a shared 0–90,000 axis; no normalization or rescaling was introduced
preserveIntent.notes: All values are copied from OpenAI’s official appendix. The horizontal grouped layout keeps the smaller DeepSeek and Kimi bars visible without fake normalization.

qualityChecks.label: Grouped horizontal layout planned
qualityChecks.detail: Three model groups, two bars per group, a shared 0–90,000 TPS/kW axis, direct labels, and a wide left plot were planned before JSON authoring.

qualityChecks.label: Exact official OpenAI data
qualityChecks.detail: 85,448 vs 44,960; 19,641 vs 11,781; and 18,195 vs 11,862 match the OpenAI appendix exactly.

qualityChecks.label: Mixed-scale readability
qualityChecks.detail: A horizontal grouped chart is used instead of a misleading normalized index; every bar retains its exact TPS/kW value.

qualityChecks.label: KO/EN data parity
qualityChecks.detail: KO and EN use identical x order, numeric values, series order, series colors, source URL, and comparison hardware.

qualityChecks.label: Paperlogy hierarchy
qualityChecks.detail: canvasHeight is 540, the title uses Paperlogy 900, and the subtitle uses Paperlogy 300.

qualityChecks.label: Render overflow
qualityChecks.detail: Export and visual preflight are reserved for the parent lane.

narrative.story: 막대가 길수록 같은 전력으로 더 많은 AI 작업을 처리합니다. Jalapeño는 GPT-OSS, DeepSeek, Kimi 세 모델에서 모두 비교 GPU보다 높은 값을 기록했습니다.
